name: @myne/preview
//: The theme-preview snapshot (myne#394) — the real editor's DOM and the real stylesheet, captured FROM the running desktop app by e2e/capture/theme-preview.capture.ts, plus the ONE implementation of applying a palette to it. Consumed as SOURCE by the website's theme builder and by the myne-themes gallery renderer, so a person deciding whether they like a theme is looking at Myne rather than at three separately hand-written imitations of it. `apply.mjs` is plain ESM rather than TypeScript because the gallery renderer is a Node CLI that can import neither .ts nor @myne/ornaments; it takes its vocabulary from the captured stylesheet instead. src/preview.{html,css} are ARTEFACTS: never hand-edit them, re-run the capture.
